_status: Module 3, Lesson 3.3 'At your desk, in the server room' (learner guide of 21 October 2026), word for word. Every control has two sides: what you do at your desk, and what IT sets up in the server room.
prompt: Whose side is it on? **You need to understand both, even if you only do the first.**

items.text: Turn on MFA wherever it is offered; deny prompts you did not start
MFA first on email, VPN and admin accounts; security keys for admins
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.

items.text: Never share your login, not even with your supervisor
Roles that match job functions; separate admin accounts
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.

items.text: Tell IT the day someone joins, moves or leaves
Quarterly access reviews; a log of every privileged action
items.why: What IT sets up; ask for it, and know it is there.
